questions.prompt: Write about one effective way to improve English in 120–180 words.
questions.explanationZh: 先明确方法，再给出两点理由，最后总结。
questions.sourceNote: Original exercise modeled on the official CET-4 format
questions.referenceAnswer: One effective way to improve English is to build a daily reading habit. Short articles provide useful words in context and make grammar easier to understand. Learners can begin with ten minutes a day, underline new expressions, and write one sentence with each expression. More importantly, reading should be followed by a brief review. With steady practice, learners will gradually read faster and express their ideas more clearly.
